title: Recurring hub — Details composition
question: Tabs are locked (Details · Past events · Recurrence · Settings). Which Details composition should we build?

options.label: Overview twin
options.thesis: Same two-column Details overview as the event hub. Series lives only in chrome meta (Weekly · next).
options.viewport: Quiet chrome + peer tabs. Details: photo | when/where card, Hosts, Visibility. Edit / Change photo panels.
options.risk: Series cadence is easy to miss until you open Recurrence.

options.label: Series strip
options.thesis: Event-hub twin overview plus one quiet Active series strip above the card (frequency, remaining, create-before).
options.viewport: Same shell; thin series bar then two-column overview.
options.risk: Strip can feel like a second header if it gets too loud.

options.label: Stacked series
options.thesis: Full-width cover, then when/where and Series as stacked text — denser, less Luma two-column.
options.viewport: Cover on top; series facts as plain rows under details.
options.risk: Diverges from the approved event-hub overview grammar.
